g.text: DEPLOY-2 enrollment composition: all nine corpus–encoder combinations (N=3)
Points and conditional 95% paired-speaker bootstrap intervals; 10,000 resamples. No multiplicity adjustment.
Balanced N=3 uses a frozen three-class subset; the first two panels are descriptive pipeline/composition comparisons, not isolated causal effects.
